_comment: Hand-maintained facts merged into monsters.json by build-dataset.py, keyed by task slug. Item rules name groups from items.json: anyOf = any one of these groups satisfies the rule; level = required or recommended. finishingItem.threshold is the Hitpoints at or below which the item finishes the kill. prayer and style are display text. reviewed = checked by hand against the wiki prose on the date given.
